gloss.魔氣暴走: If a fight drags past turn 10 (turn 15 for a Boss fight — except the Master's fight, which still uses turn 10), every monster gains +1 Claw at the start of each monster turn, stacking further each turn after that. Stalling gets more expensive the longer it goes on.
gloss.飽足: Your energy for playing cards. You start each turn full with 3 Rice Balls; playing a card eats Rice Balls equal to its cost. Run out and you can only play 0-cost cards.
gloss.飯糰: The unit of Fullness. Playing a card spends Rice Balls; you're topped back up at the start of each turn.
gloss.蓄氣: Fengfeng's own resource, capped at 12, carried over between turns. Only cards that say "spend" or "exhaust" Qi actually consume it. When an attack or block card spends 4 or more Qi at once, that card's damage or Curl is multiplied ×1.3 (a card that spends exactly 4 still counts; cards that just power up your next hit don't). Qi resets to 0 when you go down or the fight ends.
gloss.蜷縮: Curl up into a ball to block damage. It lasts until the start of your next turn, then resets to 0.
gloss.防禦: A monster's damage shield. It lasts until its next action, then resets to 0.
gloss.同生共死: These monsters are linked: as long as one of the group is still standing, any that go down will crawl back up after a few turns. You have to take them all out together for it to count.
gloss.僕從護體: While its minions are still standing, this monster takes no damage at all. Take out all the minions first before you can hit the main body.
gloss.無敵: It's recovering — no damage gets through this turn. Wait until it's back up to hit it.
gloss.重生中: It's down but still linked to a partner, and will crawl back up when the counter hits 0. Clear out its partner now while you can!
gloss.蓄力: Its next attack deals double damage. Stun it to make that attack whiff.
gloss.叼著小魚乾: It's carrying all the Dried Fish it stole in its mouth. Defeat it and you get it all back — let it escape and it's gone for good.
gloss.越戰越勇: It grows stronger on its own every few turns; the number shows how many turns are left until the next power-up. The longer the fight drags on, the more dangerous it gets.
gloss.打倒回血: You heal when you defeat it. Taking it out first can help you last longer.
gloss.隱身: A monster's attack is blocked by Curl first; only the hit that Curl can't fully absorb consumes 1 stack of Stealth and whiffs entirely (if Curl blocks it fully, no Stealth is spent). Multi-hit attacks check this separately for each hit. Pierce attacks ignore Curl and check Stealth directly. Stacks can keep piling up.
gloss.連抓: The number of cards you've already played this turn before this one.
gloss.爪力: Each point adds 1 damage to your attacks, for the whole fight.
gloss.貓步: Each point adds 1 to the Curl you gain, for the whole fight.
gloss.翻肚: Damage you take is multiplied ×1.5. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.
gloss.懶洋洋: Damage you deal is multiplied ×0.75. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.
gloss.炸毛: Curl you gain is multiplied ×0.75. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.
gloss.中毒: Deals damage equal to its stacks at the start of the turn, then loses 1 stack.
gloss.減益: Statuses that work against you: Belly-Up, Lazy, Frazzled, Poison, and Stun.
gloss.反彈: Every time you're hit by an attack, deal damage back to the attacker equal to its stacks.
gloss.看破: Strips half of your Stealth and Dive stacks (3 becomes 1, 2 becomes 1). If the same attack also deals damage, the strip happens first — so stacking up Stealth to tank it only gets you half the value.
gloss.破功: This attack strips half your Claw and half your Catstep before hitting you.
gloss.穿透: Curl can't block this hit — only Stealth, Stun, or a "didn't see it" full-turn damage immunity can stop it.
gloss.定身: Locks the target down. A stunned monster can't perform its next action at all (attacking, stealing Dried Fish, stacking Block — none of it; passive Block growth like Scales or Adamant still happens though), but against monsters this only has a 70% chance to land. If you're stunned, you can't play Attack cards this turn.
gloss.潛水: Grants Stealth equal to its stacks at the start of your next turn.
gloss.鐵布衫: Grants Curl equal to its stacks at the start of your next turn.
gloss.不壞身: At the end of every turn it gains Block equal to its stacks, and that Block never resets — it just keeps piling up. If you don't keep attacking it, you'll never break through.
gloss.下回合蜷縮: Grants Curl equal to its stacks at the start of your next turn (left behind by Iron Shirt).
gloss.下回合隱身: Grants Stealth equal to its stacks at the start of your next turn.
gloss.壞毛病: Junk cards stuffed into your deck. Most can't be played and just clog your hand; a few (like Slime and Seeing Stars) can be played, and playing them makes them vanish.
gloss.小魚乾: The tower's universal currency. The Cannery takes this.
gloss.本局代碼: The random seed for this run. Entering the same code generates an identical tower — this isn't a save code; your save is stored automatically in this browser.
gloss.秘寶: Treasures that stay in effect for the whole run. All your Relics stop working while you're down.
gloss.忍具: Items you can use during battle, gone once used. How many you can carry is shown by the slots in your status bar (difficulty and Relics can change this).
gloss.罐頭鋪: The orange tabby shopkeeper's store: buy cards, Relics, and Ninja Tools, or spend Dried Fish to "Release" a card.
gloss.貓窩: A rest site: Nap to heal, or upgrade a card. From difficulty 4 up, the Cat Bed on floor 44 also offers "All-Out Prep": upgrade a card, heal 10% of your max health, and convert all your Dried Fish into health.
gloss.紙箱: Open it to get a Relic.
gloss.大魔物: A tougher monster. Defeating one always drops a Relic.
gloss.塔主: The final fight of this act.
gloss.消耗: Once played, this card won't return to your deck for the rest of this fight.
gloss.保留: This card stays in your hand at the end of the turn instead of being discarded.
gloss.不可打出: This card can't be played — it just takes up space in your hand.
gloss.虛幻: If it's still in your hand at the end of the turn, it vanishes instead of going to your discard pile.
gloss.縮殼: The first time it takes damage, it pulls into its shell, instantly gains Block equal to its stacks, and the status disappears. This only triggers once per fight.
gloss.飛行: It's flying, so your attacks only deal half damage. Every hit that damages it (Poison doesn't count) removes 1 stack; once it hits 0, it gets knocked down and won't take flight again this fight.
gloss.鱗甲: It gains Block equal to its stacks at the end of its turn; every hit that damages it (Poison doesn't count) chips off 1 stack.
gloss.沉睡: It's asleep and does nothing; it loses 1 stack every turn that passes. Dealing damage wakes it up immediately — and it wakes up angry.
gloss.消散: It'll dissipate on its own in a few turns. Dissipating doesn't count as a kill and drops no loot — defeat it before then if you want the reward.
gloss.分裂: At half health, it splits into two smaller copies; the original doesn't count as defeated. Each copy's health equals what was left when it split.
gloss.詛咒: Every time you play a Skill card, it shuffles a junk card into your draw pile.
gloss.憤怒: Playing a Skill card makes it a little stronger, but it can only be provoked once per turn.
gloss.自爆: It explodes: it hits you hard first, then goes down itself (counted as your kill, so you still get the loot).
gloss.虛化: Its body turns translucent, so it takes at most 1 damage per hit. It'll become solid again on its next turn — save your big hits for then.
gloss.黏液: Junk a monster stuffs into your hand. It costs 1 Rice Ball to discard, and discarding it Exhausts it. It disappears once the fight ends.
gloss.眼冒金星: Junk a monster stuffs into your hand. It costs no Rice Balls and Exhausts when played, but drawing it is effectively one less real card draw. It disappears once the fight ends.
gloss.迷魂: Dazed by the incense: this turn its attack hits its neighbor instead (the one on the right first; if there's no neighbor, the attack whiffs). Any debuff it applies to you still lands. It snaps out of it once this turn is over.
